entries.summary: Collect feedback inside your apps and review agent plans
entries.details_markdown:
Project maintainers can connect websites, React Native apps, and Flutter apps to their feedback console. Customers can describe a bug or idea, discover similar requests to upvote, discuss details, and follow progress using their existing app account.

Connect an agent on your own machine or server to prepare implementation plans. Choose requests yourself or enable automatic planning for new feature requests. Review each complete plan, request changes, reject it, or approve it for implementation. Approval opens the path to a draft pull request; it never merges the change automatically.

Website builders and CMS pages can also paste a hosted iframe without installing an SDK or creating a backend. Visitors choose **Sign in through monochange** to share feedback using their monochange account. The form fills the embedded panel and opens sign-in separately, so browsers do not need third-party cookies. An **Open feedback portal** link remains available when popups are blocked.

entries.summary: Keep projects with the correct GitHub organization
entries.details_markdown: Projects and their settings stay with the correct GitHub organization when a former name is reused by another account.

Refreshing a sign-in result can no longer submit the same attempt to GitHub again. If GitHub sign-in fails, start again from the sign-in page. During heavy sign-in traffic, the site may ask you to wait briefly and try again.
